PRstage@BLINDER_4100@ver_1_1.gdtf._notes: Page states 200 W (4 x 50 W COB). The GDTF description says 400 W. No weight or CCT published.

PRstage@BSW_400_CMY@Ver_1.6.gdtf._notes: Product page gives 13.4 kg; the manual (https://prstage.pro/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/PRSTAGE_BSW_400_CMY_rus-3.pdf) gives 16.4 kg; 16.4 is used. Lux (5 m @2 deg) and zoom 2-53 come from the manual. Page: beam 2-17, wash 11-53. Pan 540 or 630.

PRstage@Beam_295_Ring@ver_1.28.gdtf._notes: Value from the official user manual (PDF linked on the product page): lux 296900 @10 m (2 deg). Light source 295 W R14 lamp.

PRstage@Beam_LED_200_Ring@Ver_1.1.gdtf._notes: Value from the official user manual (PDF linked on the product page): lux 119000 @5 m at 2 deg, CCT 13000 K, IP20.

PRstage@Dimmer_Pack_4@Ver_1_02.gdtf._notes: 4400 W is the stated maximum consumption, i.e. the load capacity (10 A/channel, 20 A total). It is not the device's own draw.

PRstage@F-Spot_800_CMY@Ver_121.gdtf._notes: Value from the official user manual (PDF linked on the product page): lux 115000 @5 m (5 deg), zoom 5-50, CTO 2700-10000 K (https://prstage.pro/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/PRSTAGE_F-SPOT_800_CMY_rus.pdf).

PRstage@F400Z@Ver_1.71.gdtf._notes: Value from the official user manual (PDF linked on the product page): lux 30400 @5 m (7 deg). 10.55 kg net, 12 kg packed.

PRstage@FRESNEL_300_RGBAL@Ver_2.0.gdtf._notes: Value from the official user manual (PDF linked on the product page): lux 6400 @5 m (15 deg), manual zoom 15-50, IP20 (https://prstage.pro/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Fresnel_300_RGBAL_Rus_Ver1_2.pdf). 8 kg net, 10 kg packed.

PRstage@FRESNEL_400_RGBALC@Ver_2.0_-_Upd._notes: Zoom 15-50 is motorised and manual. Lux 8400 @5 m (15 deg) and CCT 2000-10000 K come from the manual (https://prstage.pro/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/PRstage_Fresnel_400_RGBALC_rus.pdf).

PRstage@Haze_Tour_1500_Oil@Ver_1.1.gdtf._notes: Page: 550 W heater, 650 W consumption. The manual says 1600 W, which looks copied from the FOG 1500 text. The GDTF description says 1500 W.

PRstage@LED_BAR_424_RGBUV@Ver1.6.gdtf._notes: No beam angle on the page (the GDTF description says 60 deg). The manual's lux line is identical to the Fresnel 400 text, so it is not used.

PRstage@LED_COB_200_RGBW@Ver_1_01.gdtf._notes: Lux 1020 @5 m (60 deg) comes from the manual. 6 kg net, 8 kg packed.

PRstage@Led_Followspot_300@Ver_1_03.gdtf._notes: 14.8 kg net, 36 kg in case. Lux 40800 @5 m (1 deg) comes from the manual. CT wheel 3200/3400/14650 K.

PRstage@PAR_2410_RGBW+UV@Ver_1.3.gdtf._notes: Lux 1240 @5 m (25 deg) comes from the manual.

PRstage@PAR_543_RGBW@Ver_1_4.gdtf._notes: The manual gives 1020 lux @5 m at 60 deg, which conflicts with the page's 25 deg beam, so lux is left out.

PRstage@PROFILE_300_RGBAL@Ver_1.1.gdtf._notes: The manual gives 10.9 kg and CTO 2000-8000 K. Its lux text (6400 @5 m) is identical to the Fresnel 300 manual, so it is not used.

PRstage@PROFILE_PRO_300_RGBALC@Ver_2_03.._notes: Manual zoom 15-38 deg. Lux 7500 @5 m (15 deg) and CTO 2000-10000 K come from the manual.

PRstage@SPOT_460_CMY@Ver_1_4.gdtf._notes: Pan 540 or 630 selectable. IP20 comes from the manual.

PRstage@WALL1810@Final.gdtf._notes: Page gives 3 kg; manual gives 1.5 kg and 220 W.

PRstage@WASH_0740B_RGBL@Ver_1.92.gdtf._notes: Lux 13300 @5 m (3.5 deg) and CTO 2800-6000 K come from the manual; the manual gives 5.6 kg.

PRstage@WASH_1240B_RGBL@Ver_1.3.gdtf._notes: Lux 24300 @5 m (3.5 deg) comes from the manual. CCT is the range of the manual's colour-temperature presets (2800-8000 K). Pan 540 or 360.

PRstage@WASH_1240Z_RGBL@ver_1_2.gdtf._notes: Page says 14 x 40 W RGBW. CCT is the range of the manual's presets. The manual's lux table has no distance labels, so it is not used.
